limitations: Whole inferred floor is a visual reinterpretation and may differ in tile phase/size/palette from original
Extraction masks retain baked source lighting and small shadow/context edging
Furniture assemblies are compound components; occluded internals not claimed recovered
Reusable reconstruction is not pixel identical; exact reconstruction alone matches source
Not all tiny debris or secondary furnishings have individual masks; retained in exact visible base, absent when not separately masked in reusable mode
Rug design and saturation are inferred and differ from source where completed
Some source cutouts deliberately retain small floor/background context rectangles to preserve whole object outlines; this is a reviewable kit study, not a polished seamless production kit
Original-source phase swatches supplied alongside larger-scale inferred textures; neither claims seamless tiling
reusable.claim: Inferred reusable interpretation; completed surfaces/objects are not recovered hidden source pixels and are not claimed pixel-exact.
